SECOND SON ADAPTIVE - HARDWARE VALIDATION (run on your PC; about 30 minutes)
=============================================================================
These are the checks that cannot be done on a build server: they need your GPU, your game
files and your hands. Tick each one, then run COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS.cmd and keep diagnostics.zip.
Every line in quotes is text to look for in user\log\shad_log.txt (or CUSA00223.log).

A. STARTS AND RUNS LIKE THE 4 GB BUILD (baseline preserved)
  [ ] A1  The game boots to the title screen. Log has "Adaptive optimizer: mode automatic".
  [ ] A2  Load a save, play 5 minutes in the open city. No new crash or graphics problem
          compared with plain infamous-pc 1.1.0 on this PC.
  [ ] A3  Log has "Texture cache: memory budget ... MB" (the 4 GB memory handling is active).
  [ ] A4  With SS_ADAPTIVE=0 set (open cmd in this folder: set SS_ADAPTIVE=0 then
          PLAY_SECOND_SON.cmd) the log says "Adaptive optimizer: disabled" and the game runs.

B. NATIVE MOUSE AND KEYBOARD
  [ ] B1  Log has either "Mouse aim: camera hook at" (true mouse look) or
          "Mouse aim: camera hook NOT installed (...)". Write down which: ______________
  [ ] B2  If installed: once you walk around freely the log gets "Mouse aim: gameplay camera live"
          and moving the mouse turns the camera immediately, with no stick-like acceleration.
  [ ] B2b Spray painting (the billboard at the start): the pointer follows the mouse (motion
          sensor), left click sprays, G / H tilt, T shakes the can.
  [ ] B2c The panel at the bottom left lists the keys (Space = Cross, ...); Home hides it.
  [ ] B3  - and = change the speed (a notice appears); restart: the speed is remembered.
  [ ] B4  Left click shoots, right click aims; the click that focuses the window does not shoot.
  [ ] B5  F7 releases the mouse (cursor visible), F7 again captures it.
  [ ] B6  W A S D move, Space jumps, Shift dashes, C melee, F interact, Q / E powers, Enter / Esc
          pause, arrows D-pad, R / Y touchpad halves (drain a smoke vent / neon sign).
  [ ] B7  Spray-can scene: G / H tilt, T shakes (the 4 GB build's motion keys still work).
  [ ] B8  Delete = mouse as touchpad (use on a fingerprint scanner), Delete again returns to
          mouse look.
  [ ] B9  Menus, cut-scenes and pause: the camera does not jump when gameplay resumes.
  [ ] B10 A controller (if you have one) still works alongside keyboard and mouse.

C. OPTIMIZER - SAFE BY DEFAULT
  [ ] C1  F1 opens the optimizer window; it shows FPS, frame times, VRAM, "Limit: ..." and the
          mouse camera state.
  [ ] C2  In Manual mode (F1 window) nothing changes by itself: "Values in effect" stay at their defaults.
  [ ] C3  Quit normally. user\adaptive\latest-report.txt exists and lists your CPU, RAM and
          "NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650" with the driver version.

D. OPTIMIZER - CALIBRATION (needs 4-6 short launches)
  Set Calibration in F1 (or mode = calibration in user\adaptive\settings.ini). For each launch:
  start, reach the title screen, then do not touch anything for 2 minutes, then close the window.
  [ ] D1  Launch 1 note in the report: "this launch measures the baseline".
  [ ] D2  Later launches: "this launch tests <SETTING>=<value> against <default>", and at the
          end "calibration: <SETTING>=<value> improved|neutral|regressed (median a -> b ms ...)".
  [ ] D3  A value marked improved is listed as "learned" and is applied on the next launch
          (log: "Adaptive: start-up value ... (learned or under test)").

E. OPTIMIZER - AUTOMATIC DURING GAMEPLAY
  Set Automatic in F1. Play normally in the city for 10+ minutes.
  [ ] E1  If VRAM gets tight, F1 shows "Measuring SS_TEXCACHE_GC_HEADROOM_MB ..." and later a
          decision with its evidence (kept or reverted). No visible stutter is caused by it.
  [ ] E2  Recent decisions never show a change to graphics, vblank, present mode or async
          compute (those may only appear as recommendations).

F. BASELINE vs OPTIMIZED (the performance claim - only these numbers count)
  Same save, same spot, same time of day, warm shader cache, F10 counter on:
  [ ] F1  SS_ADAPTIVE=0:  average FPS ______  worst frame ______ ms (stand still 60 s)
  [ ] F2  Learned profile (Automatic, after calibration): average FPS ______ worst ______ ms
  If F2 is not better, the optimizer should have kept the defaults - the report says why.

Send diagnostics.zip with the filled-in checklist if anything fails.
